topic_thesis: Your retirement corpus isn't a safety net; it's a slow-motion bonfire where inflation and sequence of returns risk burn your principal to zero long before you die.
strategic_angle: Expose the deceptive math behind Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWP) sold by financial influencers, showing how early market crashes and silent tax brackets turn a peaceful retirement into a financial emergency.
key_statistic: ₹2 Lakh/Month target requires a ₹5 Crore corpus, but early market drops can slash your principal by 40% in just 3 years.
target_emotion: Shock and immediate panic over broken retirement math
pinned_comment_text: Is your retirement plan built on blind hope or bulletproof math? Drop your thoughts below, or comment 'GUIDE' to get our raw SWP risk-assessment calculator! 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Focus on Tamil Nadu's middle-class obsession with 'Monthly Pension vs Mutual Fund SWP'. Expose how bank relationship managers push flawed retirement plans using Tanglish phrases like 'Retirement la நிம்மதியா இருக்கலாம்னு நினைச்சா, Mutual Fund SWP உங்களோட Principal-ஐ காலி பண்ணிடும் பாஸ்!'
